item.title: Should a 9-Year-Old Watch ‘The Hunger Games’? Why the Hell Not?!
item.description: Full disclosure: my parenting style is best described as inconsistent. Some days, I let everybody eat candy at 10 am. Other days, I’m chasing people around saying they can’t even look at a processed grain until they’ve had a vegetable paired with a protein. But when it comes to monitoring my kids’ (age 9 and 11) film selections, my husband and I are fairly cohesive. We don’t mind if they see mature themes, as long as a) we can watch with them and b) the movie’s messaging aligns with our values.
